questions.prompt: Which sentence tells about sunlight in The Sun?
What is the big idea of The Sun?
choices: The Sun gives Earth light and warmth.
Only the Sun is a star.
Only sunlight warms land and water.
questions.answer: The Sun gives Earth light and warmth.
questions.rationale: The Sun is a star. Sunlight warms land and water. Earth travels around the Sun. Together, these facts show the whole-book big idea: The Sun gives Earth light and warmth.

Page 1 gives the fact without "only". The other pages give different facts, so this choice is too small to be the whole book's big idea.
